mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, it is 51 degrees with overcast skies by the Verona Area High School, and we are currently seeing a waning crescent moon phase.
The city has shared important reminders about stormwater management permits for developers and is inviting everyone to subscribe to the city newsletter for the latest updates on city projects.

Today offers a variety of local activities including live music at Paddy Mac's, a yoga session at Insight Wellness, and the Pizza and a Pitcher event at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, you can look forward to trivia night at the Bogey Factory and Thursday night festivities at ART House.
On October 23, officers made contact with two 13-year-olds riding eMotos on Ashton Drive, resulting in citations for their parents for permitting a minor to operate a motor vehicle.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight, so stop by and enjoy a treat.
